description: Sophia Script for Windows (Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 7). The most advanced PowerShell module on GitHub for fine-tuning Windows and automating routine tasks.
notes: This package provides Sophia Script for Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 7 only.
Other editions: sophia-script, sophia-script-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2024, sophia-script-win10, sophia-script-win10-ps7, sophia-script-ltsc2019, sophia-script-ltsc2021.
pre_install: abort "This package is for Windows 11 Enterprise LTSC 2024, PowerShell 7. Detected: $ProductName (build $Build). Run 'scoop search sophia-script' to pick the right edition."
if (-not (Get-Command -Name pwsh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { warn 'This edition runs on PowerShell 7 only. Install it: scoop install main/pwsh' }
